user.title: Narwal account
user.description: Sign in with the email and password you use in the Narwal app. Your robots are found automatically.

pick.title: Choose a robot
pick.description: Several robots are linked to this account. Pick the one to add (add the integration again for the others).

manual.title: Robot details
manual.description: The robot list could not be loaded from the Narwal cloud. Enter the product key and the robot's 32-character MQTT device name (see scripts/README.md in the repository for how to find it).

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Narwal cloud.
error.invalid_device_name: The device name must be 32 hexadecimal characters.

abort.already_configured: This robot is already set up.
abort.no_devices: No robots are linked to this Narwal account. Add your robot in the Narwal app first.
abort.options_freo_s_only: These defaults are available for the Narwal Freo S only.

init.title: Freo S clean defaults
init.description: Used when a clean starts without its own mode, suction, water level, or passes, including Clean area from a voice assistant. Suction and water apply to the next clean. A change during a clean that is already running is not sent to the robot.

clean_mode.name: Clean mode
clean_mode.description: Sent with the next clean. The default is Vacuum only.

water_level.name: Water level
water_level.description: Sent with the next clean. Changing it while the robot is already cleaning does not affect the current task.

clean_passes.name: Clean passes
clean_passes.description: How many times each room is cleaned on the next clean. 1 or 2.

set_schedules.name: Set Freo S schedules
set_schedules.description: Rewrite the Freo S schedule list. Pass the full timing string, or one schedule id and whether it is enabled. The integration always writes the whole list.

timing.name: Timing list
timing.description: The full schedule string (the timing attribute). Every entry, separated by semicolons.

schedule_id.name: Schedule id
schedule_id.description: Id of one entry to enable or disable. The rest of the list is left as the robot last reported it.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn that schedule on or off.

schedule_clean_once.name: Schedule a one-time Freo S clean
schedule_clean_once.description: Add one enabled one-time clean to the Freo S schedule. The integration reads the current list first and writes the whole list back. A disabled one-time entry is reused when one exists. The time is stored as a UTC wall clock, which is how the robot displays it.

time.name: Time
time.description: Time as HH:MM. The robot shows this clock time.

rooms.name: Rooms
rooms.description: Room ids or room names from the map.

areas.name: Areas
areas.description: Home Assistant area ids already mapped to this vacuum's rooms.

mode.name: Clean mode
mode.description: Vacuum Only or Vacuum & Mop. Uses the integration default when omitted.

suction.name: Suction
suction.description: Quiet, Normal, Strong, or Max. Uses the integration default when omitted.

water.name: Water level
water.description: low, medium, or high. Uses the integration default when omitted.

passes.name: Passes
passes.description: 1 or 2. Uses the integration default when omitted.

delete_schedule.name: Delete a Freo S schedule
delete_schedule.description: Remove one schedule entry. The integration reads the current list first and writes the remaining entries. The last entry is not deleted; disable it instead.

schedule_id.name: Schedule id
schedule_id.description: Id of the entry to remove.
